newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman's Alliance Housing Bank details IPO.
newsitem.headline: Oman's Alliance Housing Bank details IPO.

text.p: Oman's new Alliance Housing Bank said on Wednesday its IPO had been 97 times oversubscribed and that the commerce ministry had authorised the allotment of shares on the basis of 1.102 for every 100 shares applied for.

"The Bank wishes to advise its subscribers that on May 12, 1997, the Ministry of Commerce and Industry authorised the allotment of the shares offered in the public issue on the basis of 1.102 shares for every 100 shares subscribed," it said.
Alliance said in a statement that when the issue closed on May 4 over 4,500 applications for shares worth 778 million rials had been received for the eight million rials worth on offer.

"The founder members are particularly pleased that the investors represent many members of the general public as well as the financial institutions who come from Oman, the GCC and other countries," it said.
"The large number of overseas applications which were received reflects the confidence with which international investors now view Oman," it added.
Alliance will be the first private specialist housing bank in Oman.
